reserveReview.rationale: Maple documents a USDC-denominated claim on a segregated portfolio of institutional loans and supporting yield strategies. The legal risk disclosure states FIFO withdrawals depend on available liquidity and have no guaranteed maximum period, although the FAQ and operational withdrawal guide still mention 30 days. The static composition is a standing structural description rather than measured current allocation weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Standing whole-token pooled claim; pinned Ethereum accounting at block 26097123 reconciles cash and all four strategy AUM balances, but is not a look-through portfolio allocation.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The whole-token claim covers institutional loans, pool cash and supporting strategies. USDC denomination does not establish 100% USDC cash backing or 100% private-credit look-through exposure. Strategy AUM and pool cash reconcile to totalAssets, but no reconciled underlying-asset allocation is published in the reviewed sources.

sources.label: Maple custody and legal structure FAQ

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The listed provider names are retained from the historical review, not confirmed as the complete current syrupUSDC custodian set. On 2026-10-01 the current lender FAQ did not name custodians; The Network Firm dashboard verified combined syrupUSDC and syrupUSDT collateral without provider allocations or custody terms. Anchorage's case study concerns Maple treasury, token launches and borrower collateral, while the September 2026 Zodia arrangement concerns borrower-owned segregated wallets. Neither establishes a complete syrupUSDC-specific custody profile, segregation or reuse policy.
